summary: Exact main evaluates the same caller-owned FidelityManager.PolicyInputs twice on the PhysicsLabRealizer.step path: first in the server realizer's adapter precheck via selectDesiredLevel(), then again inside PhysicsLabRuntime/FidelityManager.step(). That makes the physical adapter and authoritative runtime reason over potentially different snapshots for metatable/stateful inputs, and the first evaluation occurs outside the retained PR #388 runtime mutation fence that was specifically designed to contain hostile PolicyInputs evaluation.
evidence: Inspected exact main ae83c0ef470eb2e73d99be41fd3561ede30c40e1. src/server/PhysicsLab/PhysicsLabRealizer.luau step() calls FidelityManager.selectDesiredLevel(inputs, nil, current.fidelity) before runtime:step(entityId, inputs, nowSeconds, captureState, observeTransition).

src/shared/Physics/FidelityManager.luau evaluatePolicy() validates and repeatedly dereferences caller-owned PolicyInputs; Manager.step() calls evaluatePolicy(inputs, self.config, currentLevel) again, so a proxy/metatable input can yield different values or execute callbacks on the two reads.

Exact main PhysicsLabRuntime.step() delegates the second evaluation to self._fidelity:step(). Retained PR #388 explicitly hardens that runtime path by wrapping the entire FidelityManager.step call in its transitionInFlight transaction because hostile PolicyInputs metatables can mutate/dispose during pre-hook evaluation.

PR #388 cannot cover the realizer's earlier selectDesiredLevel() call because its lane owns only PhysicsLabRuntime plus its dedicated test. The realizer precheck therefore remains outside that proposed transaction even if #388 integrates unchanged.
Retained realizer PR #349 changes only exact representation ownership (ownsRepresentation) and its source-contract regression; its patch does not alter step() or policy evaluation.

Search of current/open PRs and issues for PhysicsLabRealizer/selectDesiredLevel/PolicyInputs found no separate owner for the double-evaluation seam. No Roblox Studio or two-client evidence is implicated; this is a source/deterministic-authority boundary finding.

metadata.recommendedNext: After retained runtime/realizer lineages are schedulable, use one bounded source-only successor/leaf to make the adapter and authoritative runtime consume one validated policy decision/snapshot per step. Prefer returning/consuming the runtime decision rather than evaluating caller PolicyInputs in PhysicsLabRealizer; add an adversarial metatable/stateful-input regression proving no pre-runtime policy execution and no adapter/runtime disagreement. Do not widen #388 while its ownership/history integration is blocked.
